title: The Lighthouse That Never Answers
subject: DSA
briefing: The harbor's Lighthouse Index looks up ship IDs in a sorted list. Last night, some lookups hung forever and the dock system froze.
symptom: Most searches work, but a few never return.
hints: Find a failing case and read its trace. Does the search range keep shrinking?
Look at the trace of a failing case: what happens to lo when the value at mid is too small?
If arr[mid] < target, mid has already been checked. Why should the new lo still include it?
